title: GPT-5 Mini and Nano take their places
summary:
GPT-5 Mini and Nano joined the model lineup, while a queue fix let concurrent requests stop waiting in single file.

`openai` was restored as GPT-5 Mini, while `openai-fast` switched from GPT-4.1 Nano to GPT-5 Nano. Both accept text and images and support tools.

The per-IP queue no longer starts just one request per interval regardless of the configured concurrency cap. Token-authenticated users can use their tier-based concurrency, including the increased nectar-tier cap.

Enter now records GitHub account details at sign-in and passes account context along with proxied text and image generation requests.

highlights.title: GPT-5 Mini returns
highlights.text: Use `openai` for GPT-5 Mini with text, image inputs, and tool support. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=openai).

highlights.title: GPT-5 Nano goes fast
highlights.text: `openai-fast` now uses GPT-5 Nano, with text, image inputs, and tool support. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=openai-fast).
